topic: Why do starling flocks turn together with no leader?
title: Why Do Starling Flocks Turn Together With No Leader?
description:
Thousands of birds in the sky suddenly turn together with no leader at all. Scientists found each bird only tracks seven nearby neighbors, not the whole flock - and that's the whole secret. Up next: why a crowd starts clapping in rhythm all on its own. #starlings #murmuration #birds #nature
